body.name: Predeclared-chart subclass \(\mathcal M^{\mathrm{HL}}_{K,T}(\mathcal U,\mathcal V)\)
body.construction: \(\mathcal M^{\mathrm{HL}}_{K,T}(\mathcal U,\mathcal V)=\{P_W\in\mathcal M^{\mathrm{HL}}_{K,T}:\det H_{\mathcal U,\mathcal V}(P_W)\ne0\}\) for the ordered tuples \(\mathcal U=(u_1,\ldots,u_K)\) and \(\mathcal V=((w_1,b_1),\ldots,(w_K,b_K))\) fixed before outcomes are observed, with \(u_1=\epsilon\).
